name: CBZ Life

hero.title: Cover for your family, and for the people you employ
hero.lede: Funeral and education plans for individuals, and group life, retirement savings, annuities and credit life for employers.

about: CBZ Life provides long-term assurance for individuals and employers. Individual plans cover funeral costs and build savings towards a child's education, with life cover attached. Employee benefits cover group life, retirement savings, annuities in retirement, and credit life that settles an outstanding loan balance.
productsNote: Benefits, premiums and terms depend on the cover selected and on underwriting. Speak to a CBZ Life consultant for a quotation and the full policy terms.

contact.heading: Talk to CBZ Life
contact.body: Request a quotation for an individual plan, or speak to us about cover for your employees.

seo.title: CBZ Life: funeral, education and group life cover
seo.description: Comfortsure funeral cash plan, Sarapavana education plan, group life, retirement savings, annuities and credit life from CBZ Life.
